hints.title: Key Value Dictionary
hints.text: Store knowledge pairs into a direct mapping for constant time lookups.

hints.title: Parsing Bracket Delimiters
hints.text: Iterate through characters, buffering characters found between opening and closing parentheses.

hints.title: Key Substitution
hints.text: When a closing parenthesis is reached, substitute the buffered key with its mapped value or question mark.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: k is total length of knowledge pairs
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the knowledge list linearly for each bracketed key takes O(n * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant time lookup map evaluates the parsed string in a single linear pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate parses brackets correctly and defaults undefined keys to question mark.
